catalog.name: Watch Party
catalog.summary: Watch YouTube together in a voice channel — one shared timeline, host controls and a queue anyone can add to.
watchParty.add.duplicate: That video is already in the queue.
watchParty.add.full: The queue is full — it holds {max} videos.
watchParty.add.invalid: That isn't a YouTube video link. Paste a youtube.com/watch, youtu.be, Shorts or embed link.
watchParty.add.label: Add a YouTube link
watchParty.add.perUser: {count, plural, one {You can have # video waiting at a time.} other {You can have # videos waiting at a time.}}
watchParty.add.screenShare: Not on YouTube? Share your screen from the call controls instead.
watchParty.add.tooLong: That link is too long — at most {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}. Paste the video's own link: youtube.com/watch?v=… or youtu.be/….
watchParty.controls.noHost: Nobody is hosting right now. Take over in the Watching list to control playback.
watchParty.controls.viewerOnly: {name} is hosting, so only they can play, pause and seek.
watchParty.copyright: You're responsible for what you play. Videos stream from YouTube straight to each viewer's own player — LobbyForge doesn't download, store or re-stream them.
watchParty.error.hostHint: Pick something else from Up next, or paste a new link.
watchParty.error.notEmbeddable: The owner of this video only allows it to be played on YouTube.
watchParty.error.notFound: This video is private, was removed or doesn't exist.
watchParty.error.viewerHint: The host can pick something else.
watchParty.header.watching: {count, plural, one {# person watching} other {# people watching}}
watchParty.host.away: The host seems to be away.
watchParty.local.blocked: Press play on the video to start — you'll be synced from there.
watchParty.local.hold: You paused your player. Everyone else is still watching.
watchParty.pill.buffering: {count, plural, one {# is buffering} other {# are buffering}}
watchParty.queue.title: Up next
watchParty.stage.blocked: Your browser stopped the video from starting. Press play on the video — you'll be synced from there.
watchParty.stage.emptyBody: Paste a YouTube link and it loads here for everyone in the room.
watchParty.stage.joinBody: Your browser needs a click before a video can play with sound.
watchParty.stage.stalled: The player hasn't loaded. Check that nothing (an extension or a firewall) is blocking youtube-nocookie.com.
watchParty.title: Watch Party
watchParty.viewers.title: Watching
